body:
The complete browser interface now uses Polish, including all eight views, menus, editors, settings, native calendar/board/timeline words, recovery messages and accessibility labels. Focus retains its name. User-authored content and protocol/CLI identifiers are preserved.

The full 617-test gate, all 37 Chromium suites, 16 selected WebKit suites and broad HTTPS/planning smoke pass. The final chart/localization checks pass in both engines, including keyboard and narrow touch workflows. See progress/2026-10-04-polish-ui.md for reproducible evidence and coverage limits.

The rebuilt embedded release application is verified at its existing HTTPS address. Restart comparison preserves 37 prior source hashes/versions, both profiles, three pins, preferences, roots/registrations, identity/epoch and certificate; all 59 served assets match. Read-only paired checks cover all views, settings and phone navigation. Physical-device and full release acceptance remain open.

metadata.summary: Polish browser interface implemented and verified
